# java/google samples

Source: "Google Java Style Guide" (<https://google.github.io/styleguide/javaguide.html>), sections
"Source file structure" and "Formatting" (two-space indent, braces K&R, one top-level class, static
imports before the others), text retrieved 2026-11-16. The `.out` file is google-java-format 2.0.0's
output for the `.in` file; the guide gives rules, not one full example.
